question: I’ve heard that you can’t use magic around Reinhard, but the lesser spirits healed his injuries, so does that mean he can use spirit arts?
answer: Rather the opposite, the lesser spirits get so worked up over him they won’t listen to what he says. With Reinhard draining off all the mana, they can’t use magic properly either. Limited spirits that won’t be unfaithful, like Beako, are his only allies. Beako is great justice, after all!!
